predecessor.name: HELM-D-R4 full-decoder softmax parity
predecessor.claim_boundary: Gauge-equivalent coherent R4/Spin softmax attention parity only; no intrinsic-curvature advantage was established.

question: Can product-H^4 attention over transported four-lane R4 blocks retain the frozen donor and beat a separately fitted equal-budget flat-R4 distance and centroid control on document-disjoint causal next-token loss while both destructive controls lose?

chosen.name: product H^4 over sixteen R4 blocks
chosen.meaning: Sixteen ordered unit-radius four-dimensional hyperbolic Lorentz factors, one per four-spatial-lane R4 block in each 64-lane head.
chosen.transport_lift: The existing spatial R in SO(4) lifts to diag(1,R) in every Lorentz factor.
tradeoffs: Non-flat and native to the existing sixteen R4 blocks.
Preserves the already qualified UOR Spin/H4 spatial frame substrate.
Adds compiler-side sqrt, acosh, and timelike-domain failure modes.
Retains ordinary stable causal softmax and therefore makes no deployed-efficiency claim.

alternatives.name: ambient flat R4 squared distance and arithmetic centroid
alternatives.reason: Ambient Euclidean R4 is the plain flat baseline and receives the same 32 fitted scalars per layer and query head.

alternatives.name: S3 geodesic distance and spherical mean
alternatives.reason: It is R4-block-native but discards or separately models radial magnitude and introduces antipodal and chart singularities.

alternatives.name: full-head H^64
alternatives.reason: It is not R4-block-native, abandons the sixteen registered block actions, and introduces unsupported cross-block geometry.

consequences: Only a strict curved-over-flat result can support a bounded curvature-specific claim.
A curved and flat tie can retain functional geometric attention but cannot authorize resonance.
Any non-finite lift, invalid distance, non-timelike centroid, or transport fault fails closed without a flat fallback.
A negative may revise only the distance, barycenter, transport, or construction-fitting seam before a new frozen contract.

evidence_persistence.marker_and_terminal_content_addressing: BLAKE3 of recursively key-sorted compact JSON for D3 reveal-marker and terminal result/failure payloads; checkpoint and fit-report identities retain their declared struct-order encodings
evidence_persistence.post_reveal_startup_reconciliation: If the reveal marker exists without a terminal whose actual canonical payload CID, schema, issue, manifest CID, partition CID, reveal-marker CID, and held-out shape all verify, emit INVALID_INTRINSIC_LORENTZ_R4_POST_REVEAL_EVIDENCE without reopening D3; only PASS, RETAIN, final FAIL, or INVALID_POST_REVEAL are legal beside the marker.

positive.condition: Every final positive threshold and integrity requirement passes.
positive.consequence: Freeze the curved softmax oracle and authorize only a bounded matched multi-resonance weighting replacement.

functional_parity_without_curvature_adva.condition: Curved retains donor and gauge behavior but misses strict curved-over-flat or destructive-control separation.
functional_parity_without_curvature_adva.consequence: Preserve functional intrinsic attention without a curvature-advantage claim; resonance remains blocked.

construction_validation_negative.condition: A valid fitted curved arm misses the frozen construction-validation NLL or metric-liveness gate.
construction_validation_negative.consequence: Preserve the negative, leave final D3 NOT_RUN, and revise only distance, barycenter, transport, or construction fitting under a new freeze.

negative.condition: A complete, publishable revealed run misses donor or gauge retention or deterministic replay/decode integrity.
negative.consequence: Revise only distance, barycenter, transport, or construction fitting under a new frozen contract.

unavailable.condition: Required corpus, tokenizer, frame, fit, audit, or cheap-gate evidence is unavailable or invalid.
unavailable.consequence: Leave final held-out NOT_RUN and make no metric inference.

invalid_post_reveal.condition: Any execution error, timeout, attention/transport fault, causal or work-contract violation, or incomplete result occurs after D3 admission.
invalid_post_reveal.consequence: Record heldout_opened=true and reject the revealed run as invalid evidence; never relabel it as stopped before held-out or infer a metric verdict.

nonclaims: This pre-run contract establishes no intrinsic-attention result.
A later positive would be bounded to this frozen population, decoder, and operator.
No softmax removal, subquadratic inference, transformerless serving, broad language quality, correctness, reasoning, energy advantage, E8 semantics, chat, or release-readiness claim is authorized.
